material.locator: ICRC, Handbook on International Rules Governing Military Operations (2013), Part I, §2.1.0.1 “International law”, p. 45.
material.description: Provides independent doctrinal context for the general concept of international law. Its introductory treatment does not independently establish an exhaustive list of international legal persons; the phrase “other recognized international-law subjects” remains subject to separate doctrinal review.
